analysis.one_line_summary: Side-by-side comparison graphic contrasting the struggle of using a separate hair dryer and round brush against the effortless salon blowout achieved with the WavyTalk thermal brush.
analysis.full_description: A square static promotional graphic set against a light lilac backdrop. At the top, the bold black 'WAVYTALK' brand logo sits above the headline 'ONE TOOL, SALON-LEVEL BLOWOUT' and the subheadline 'No more struggling with multiple tools'. Below is a two-panel split comparison: the left panel shows a desaturated black-and-white photo of a young woman with a frustrated expression trying to handle both a blow dryer and a tangled round brush, captioned 'Too many tools?' in a grey bar. The right panel shows a vibrant, full-colour photo of a smiling red-haired woman effortlessly styling bouncy, polished curls using the pink WavyTalk Blowout Boost heated round brush, captioned 'Just one tool!' in a vivid pink bar.

on_screen_text.text: No more struggling with multiple tools

scenes.visual: A split-screen composition on a pale lilac studio background. Left panel: black-and-white photo of a woman looking annoyed while juggling a hair dryer and round brush. Right panel: full-colour photo of a smiling woman using the pink WavyTalk thermal brush on styled auburn hair.
scenes.action: Comparison between multi-tool styling struggle and single-tool styling ease.
